title: Robert Pattinson announced as new James Bond
summary: Robert Pattinson will take on the iconic role of James Bond, Amazon MGM Studios announced on Monday morning.

image.caption: Actor Robert Pattinson is set to play the next James Bond. (Jaap Buitendijk/Amazon MGM Studios)

blocks.text: Robert Pattinson will take on the iconic role of James Bond, Amazon MGM Studios announced on Monday morning.
English actor known for his roles in Twilight, Batman and The Odyssey will star as 007
"James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honour of a lifetime," Pattinson said in a press release from the studio.
Pattinson is coming off the roles of Antinous in The Odyssey and Chris Hanson in Primetime.
The upcoming film will be directed by Denis Villeneuve, with a script by Steven Knight.
Philip Drost is a network senior writer for CBC News based in Fredericton. You can reach him at philip.drost@cbc.ca.
